messages:
maria: quick sync — proposing a new "telemetry-gating" header + a compact telemetry mode to cut both PII surface area and telemetry egress cost. idea: clients can opt-in per-request (or we can enforce per-route) to send a compact envelope instead of full req/resp bodies.

maria: example header: `X-Redwood-Telemetry: mode=compact; reason=inspect; ttl=3600` and compact body schema below.

raj: can you sketch what "compact" actually contains? devs will want enough to debug production issues.

maria: minimal fields: route_id, request_id, timestamp, provenance (client_id, region), proto_hash (fast rolling hash of prompt/request), shortened intent labels, and an optional ephemeral inspect_token when breakglass is used. no raw request/response text.

maria: compact JSON example:
```
{
  "route_id": "chat-v1",
  "request_id": "r123",
  "ts": 1672500000,
  "client": "web-sdk",
  "proto_hash": "sha256:abcd...",
  "intent": "qa",
  "sample_salt": "s1",
  "inspect_token": null
}
```

dina: +1 for reducing surface area. question: how do we reconcile this with inspect/console flows that currently replay full payloads? i.e., if compact mode is enabled we can't replay.

taylor: we should treat compact mode as "no-replay" by default. breakglass flow can mint a short-lived inspect_token that lets authorized users fetch an ephemeral view from the customer (or replay) store — only for audit roles.

sylvie: how does this affect quota/billing metrics? compact requests are cheaper in bytes but still consume the same compute tokens in our billing model.

taylor: proposal: telemetry should report a telemetry_weight metric. compact mode => telemetry_weight=0.1 (less storage/ingest). Billed compute/token stays unchanged. Console cost dashboards get a new column "telemetry weight" so customers can see telemetry spend separately.

raj: hmm we need to ensure customers understand quotas. If compact reduces our ingest but not compute, customers might think they're saving money incorrectly.

maria: UX note — in Console route settings: show a toggle "Compact telemetry (redacts full request/response)" with a tooltip: "Reduces telemetry retention and PII exposure. Debugging may require breakglass." Add a small learn-more link to rollout plan.

dina: rollout proposal: default off for all routes, enable default-on for internal routes and a 5% canary for customer-facing routes. we should instrument rollout so we can back out quickly.

sylvie: security: inspect_token issuance must be logged to audit and gated by RBAC + SSO approval. also store only salted/hashes with per-tenant salt to avoid cross-tenant correlation.

maria: technical detail: proto_hash should be computed client-side when possible, otherwise gateway computes a fast rolling hash then drops raw text if compact mode requested. For embeddings attempts we should additionally drop raw vectors and only keep vector_ids/hashes.

raj: sampling interaction: if route-level sampler is set to sample 1% for full payloads, how does compact interact? e.g., do we sample compact telemetry more broadly to preserve metrics?

maria: idea: sampling_decision is orthogonal. we keep current sampling rules, but add an override: `telemetry_sample_rate` which can be higher for compact mode because it contains no PII. e.g., full_payload_sample=0.01, compact_sample=0.1.

 taylor: we need schema for ingestion pipeline so downstream parsers can distinguish compact envelopes. add `telemetry_format: "compact_v1"` header field.

maria: good call. Also adding a `reason` label (canary, breakglass, optin) will help queries.

opsbot: deploybot: "staging rollout started for telemetry-gating (canary 5%) — job 9843"

dina: ops question: can we keep a short TTL on compact telemetry too? e.g., 7d retention default vs 30d for full payloads to reduce risk.

sylvie: yes. default retention: compact=7d, full=30d (configurable per-tenant and per-route). ensure retention is surfaced in Console billing/retention UI.

raj: one more: debugability — we should offer an ephemeral restore flow where a customer approves re-ingest of full payload for a single request for up to N minutes. audit logs + SSO required.

maria: action items:
- I'll open an RFC with schema: headers, compact_v1 body, sampling semantics, retention defaults (A: 1718223345 will be RFC id in the ticket)
- @taylor to propose telemetry_weight mapping for billing dashboard
- @sylvie to draft RBAC + audit flow for inspect_token
- @dina to design canary rollout plan (5% -> 25% -> 100%) and abort criteria

maria: timeline: want RFC + console mockups by EOD Wed, canary next week if no blockers.

taylor: will put a short patch for metrics column on the dashboard — target Mon.

sylvie: I'll prototype token issuance flow and list of required audit fields.

raj: thanks — leaning yes. let's capture edgecases in the RFC re: embeddings, attachments, and third-party plugins.

maria: thanks all. I'll drop the RFC link here when created.
